# Ayushmanbuilds

> Ayushmanbuilds is an independent web development and digital agency run by Ayushman Acharya, a full-stack developer based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, serving clients in Berhampur (Brahmapur), Odisha and across India.

Ayushman Acharya is Ayushmanbuilds' founder and lead developer — a full-stack developer and freelance digital growth specialist. He builds custom websites, e-commerce systems, web applications, SEO foundations and workflow automations for small and medium businesses (SMBs).

## Who this is for
Small and medium Indian businesses that need a website developer, digital agency, or software developer in Berhampur, Odisha, Bengaluru, or anywhere in India, including businesses looking for:
- Full stack developer in Odisha / Berhampur
- Website developer in Berhampur / Brahmapur
- Software engineer in Berhampur
- Digital agency Berhampur / Odisha
- SEO services Berhampur
- E-commerce website developer Odisha
